decision.reason: [ev-73d501ad9fa3] is just the bare list item "- component" from the upgrade guide's `service_name` label section. Without the text around it, it says nothing about what the list means: whether "component" is a source label used to fill in service_name, a label that was added or removed, or something else. There is no before/after, no exposure condition and no consequence. We need the paragraph that introduces this list (the earlier lines of the `service_name` label section) so it is clear what role "component" plays and what changed.
